source_caption:
🎥🎬: Street Fighter (2026)

In a world filled with legendary fighters, Ryu and Ken are drawn into a dangerous underground tournament where the strongest martial artists from around the globe come together. What begins as a chance to test their skills quickly becomes something much bigger.

As the fighters encounter powerful opponents including Chun-Li, Guile, Blanka, Dhalsim, and M. Bison, rivalries and personal motives begin colliding. Each fighter has their own reason for entering the tournament, but the battle eventually reveals a larger threat behind the competition.

With M. Bison’s ambitions putting everyone in danger, Ryu and the other fighters must push their abilities to the limit. The tournament becomes more than a fight for victory—it becomes a battle for survival and the future of the fighters themselves.

source_details.synopsis: Street Fighter is a 2026 martial arts film directed by Kitao Sakurai and written by Sakurai and T. J. Fixman, with a story by Dalan Musson and Gary Dauberman. It is the third live-action feature-length film based on the Street Fighter video game series by Capcom. The ensemble cast includes Noah Centineo, Andrew Koji, Callina Liang, Joe "Roman Reigns" Anoa'i, David Dastmalchian, Cody Rhodes, Eric André, Andrew Schulz, Vidyut Jammwal, Orville Peck, Don Lee, Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson, and Jason Momoa.
